query: Coaching institute made me sign a contract saying fees are 100% non-refundable under any circumstance even if I leave in 2 days. Is this enforceable?

model_output.summary: The coaching institute made you sign a contract stating fees are 100% non-refundable. Generally, charging the full fee for a course you left within 2 days may be considered an unfair trade practice or unreasonable loss claim, as compensation must be based on actual loss suffered rather than penalty clauses. You can approach the consumer forum or use alternate dispute methods.
facts_extracted: Coaching institute contract states fees are 100% non-refundable under any circumstance
Student left the institute in 2 days

options.title: File a Consumer Complaint
options.description: You can file a formal complaint before the District Commission through the e-Daakhil portal regarding unfair terms or deficiency in service.
pros: Provides a formal legal forum for dispute resolution
cons: Requires documentary evidence like receipts and contracts

options.title: Approach Lok Adalat
options.description: You can seek a pre-litigation settlement through the District Legal Services Authority to reach a mutual compromise with the coaching institute with no court fees.
cons: Depends on the coaching institute agreeing to participate
options.forum: District Legal Services Authority / Lok Adalat

citations.relevance: Outlines the manner in which a consumer complaint can be filed with the District Commission electronically or in person.
Governs compensation for loss or damage caused by breach of contract, limiting recovery to actual losses rather than arbitrary penalties.
Provides for organizing Lok Adalats to arrive at a pre-litigation settlement or compromise.
